messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING oncall-sre and eng: High error rate from Ironclad Bank (dedicated-vpc: dkp-iron-3) — increased websocket disconnects and 502/504s observed. Auto-alert threshold crossed (5m error rate).

oncall-sre: Ack. I'm on it, grabbing logs and current routing. Can someone pull the gateway proxy logs and LB connection stats?

mike_ops: I can grab LB metrics. Seeing spike in `upstream_response_time` and `502` from our appgw-proxy. Also seeing long TCP close_wait counts on hosts in dkp-iron-3.

jon-eng: Confirmed on our side: client reconnect loop reported by customer. They show repeated `websocket close code=1011` and quick retries. Our streaming ingress is hitting the session limit and some requests are getting 504 from internal proxy.

emma-support: Customer (Ironclad) says impact: their customer UI sees repeated 'Connection lost — reconnecting' and some requests return 504s for ~10-30s windows. They want ETA and mitigation asap.

dilip-ps: Customer has custom app gateway in front of us; they do aggressive retry backoff of 1s -> 2s. That is amplifying load. Pool is dedicated, but KV cache misses + many new sessions are spiking CPU on the serving instances.

oncall-sre: Quick mitigation plan (live): 1) Ask customer to reduce retry aggressiveness to 10s if possible. 2) Increase proxy idle_timeout to 120s temporarily (we have config toggle). 3) Scale pool dkp-iron-3 by +2 nodes (hot add). 4) Route a fraction (~20%) of traffic to fallback model_variant (lighter memory / smaller seq) for long-lived streams.

mike_ops: Running scale now: `infractl pool scale dkp-iron-3 --delta 2` — queued, should finish in ~90s. LB warm-up starting.

jon-eng: I can flip proxy timeout: editing config `gateway/proxy/timeouts: idle=120s` and will push to canary group 10%. Command: ```kubectl -n gateway apply -f proxy-timeout-120s-canary.yaml```

oncall-sre: Do that, but keep canary low. We don't want to break other customers. Also enable additional logging for streams: `GATEWAY_STREAM_DEBUG=1` for those canary pods.

emma-support: I've looped in customer success and sent Ironclad a short note: "We're scaling your pool and applying temporary timeouts; you may see reduced reconnects within 2-3 minutes. If you can shift client retry to 10s that's helpful."

siva-security: Heads up — before we change timeouts, confirm there are no idle-connection security implications for Ironclad's compliance profile. Dilip, any constraints?

dilip-ps: Ironclad allowed temporary changes under their incident SLA, CS already confirmed. No extra signing needed.

jon-eng: Canary applied. Logs show fewer abrupt closes from pods in canary group. Rolling to 30% now.

mike_ops: Scale completed: +2 nodes added to dkp-iron-3, instance ids i-0a1b2c3d, i-0d3c2b1a. CPU normalized from 92% -> 62% across pool.

incident-bot: Note: Incident severity bumped to P2 due to customer impact and SLA. Paging product and PS.

lena-product: Acknowledged. We may need to flag for a follow-up change to connection limits and better default retry guidance for enterprise integrations.

oncall-sre: After mitigations: error rate dropped to baseline in ~4m, reconnects decreased. Still seeing occasional 504s tied to a subset of client IPs (likely behind their gateway).

jon-eng: I pulled raw websocket frames — saw repeated handshake resets from a set of proxied IPs. Hypothesis: Ironclad's gateway health-check/retry logic is reusing sockets aggressively. Recommend they add per-client jitter and exponential backoff. Sharing snippet to send to customer: ```// recommended backoff pseudocode
let backoff = 10000; // 10s
function reconnect(){ setTimeout(()=> openWs(), backoff); backoff = Math.min(backoff*2, 60000); }```

emma-support: Sent that snippet and asked for confirmation that they'll adjust. They replied: "Deploying retry change to canary now, will monitor."

siva-security: Quick check: no unusual auth failures or token reuse logs. Looks safe to leave timeouts higher for now.

oncall-sre: Moving to mitigation closure steps: 1) Keep pool +2 nodes for next 2 hours, 2) roll back proxy timeout to default after 1 hour if stable, 3) schedule postmortem with Ironclad + infra + product.

incident-bot: ACTIONS assigned: oncall-sre -> monitor (2h), jon-eng -> create postmortem draft, emma-support -> coordinate with Ironclad CS, mike_ops -> confirm scaling metrics retention.

jon-eng: Creating PoAM and initial notes. Will include traffic patterns, websocket close codes, and recommendations (timeout defaults, client retry guidance, connection reuse limits).

emma-support: Customer updated: canary retry change reduced reconnection rate by ~80% on their side. They're happy with current state but want long-term prevention plan.

dilip-ps: Recommend we add an integration doc for enterprise customers: recommended LB idle timeouts, socket pool sizing, and example client jitter/backoff. I'll draft it with product.

lena-product: Good ask. We'll own the integration guide and include it in onboarding for dedicated pools.

oncall-sre: Closing live mitigation. Monitoring for 30m, then demote severity if no regression. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident status changed -> monitoring. Severity -> P3 if stable after 30m.

jon-eng: Postmortem draft: `pm-1749004321-ironclad-ws-timeouts.md` (internal link). Will circulate tomorrow.
summary: Enterprise (Ironclad Bank) dedicated VPC pool experienced streaming websocket disconnects and proxy 504s due to aggressive client retries and session limits; live mitigations included scaling pool, increasing proxy idle_timeout for canary, routing fraction to lighter variant, and customer changing retry behavior. Assigned post-incident actions and integration doc follow-up.
